subject: SunForge CIO demo — aligning exec attendance and backup coverage
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@sunforge.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunforge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SunForge CIO demo — aligning exec attendance and backup coverage

Hi Sanjay/Claire,

Thanks for taking the meeting discovery with Jenna last week — appreciate the context. We'd like to schedule a focused exec intro and demo for your CIO and VP of Engineering to show how Redwood Inference could reduce inference costs and simplify model rollouts.

Request: 30–40 minute slot with the CIO (brief exec-level 10–12min overview + 20–25min technical Q&A). We can compress to 35 minutes if the CIO's window is tight.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-09-01 10:00–10:35
- Wed 2026-09-02 14:00–14:35
- Thu 2026-09-03 09:00–09:35

Attached is a short 1-page agenda and our suggested attendee roles. If none of these work, tell us the CIO's available windows and we'll prioritize accordingly. Also let us know whether your VP can join — if not, we'll confirm an internal backup who can cover the technical deep dive.

Attachments: MVP-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks,

David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@sunforge.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunforge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SunForge CIO demo — aligning exec attendance and backup coverage

David —

Thanks, appreciate the concise plan. Short version: CIO Ravi has only two 30–45 minute pockets next week: Wed 09/02 08:30–09:15 PT (tight) and Thu 09/03 09:00–09:45 PT. VP of Eng (Marissa) is tentatively available Thu morning but she needs the invite to confirm.

We'd prefer a tighter agenda (35 minutes) focused on business impact (cost/latency) + one example of rollout safety. Can you confirm you can run a compressed flow and who from your side will own the technical deep dive? Also send a two-sentence executive summary for the invite.

I'll loop Claire to lock the calendar once we confirm.

— Sanjay
Director, Technical Programs
SunForge
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SunForge CIO demo — quick cover plan

On Sat, 29 Aug 2026, Sanjay Rao wrote:
> David —
> 
> Thanks, appreciate the concise plan. Short version: CIO Ravi has only two 30–45 minute pockets next week...

Team —

We need to be able to run a 35-minute compressed demo for Thu 09/03 09:00 PT (preferred) or Wed 09/02 08:30 PT (fall-through). Proposal:
- Ben: lead the exec narrative (10 min) — value, SLO guarantees, cost delta vs current.
- Soojin: 18–20 min technical deep dive showing a single customer-ready flow (routing + KV-cache savings + fallback model). Keep it high-level and ready to drop into 10 min if the CIO cuts us off.
- Me: handle procurement/SLA questions and follow-ups, and have SOW draft available.

I attached the SOW draft and our 1-pager. Can you both confirm you can run this compressed and highlight any slides to cut? Ben — can you provide that 2-sentence exec summary for Sanjay to include in the invite?

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.docx, Redwood-dedicated-brief.pdf

-David
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@sunforge.com>, Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunforge.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SunForge CIO demo — aligning exec attendance and backup coverage

Hi Sanjay/Claire —

Thanks for the options. We can definitely compress to ~35 minutes. Proposed compressed agenda:
1) Exec value (Ben) — 8–10 min: cost, latency, unified serving model
2) Technical snapshot (Soojin) — 18–20 min: live flow, contiguous KV-cache example, fallback behavior
3) Next steps & procurement (David) — 5 min

Candidate times (all PT):
- Wed 2026-09-02 08:30–09:05
- Thu 2026-09-03 09:00–09:35

If Thu 9:00 is best we can send a calendar invite. Two-sentence summary you can use for the invite: "Redwood Inference will demonstrate how a unified inference runtime can cut model serving costs by 30–50% while preserving latency SLOs, and show a safe rollout pattern for model updates. Ben Carter (SVP Solutions) will lead the exec portion and Soojin Lee (Principal Engineer) will cover a focused technical example."

We will publish the slides and test dial-in by COB Wed 9/02.

Best,
Ben
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@sunforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@sunforge.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SunForge CIO demo — aligning exec attendance and backup coverage

Thanks Ben — Thu 2026-09-03 09:00–09:35 PT works for Ravi (CIO) and Marissa (VP Eng) is tentatively marked as attending. Please send the calendar invite when ready. Two asks before the session:

1) Could you drop the slide deck (PDF) and the short dial-in test script to this Drive link by EOD Wed 9/02: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1DemoPrep
2) Please confirm the meeting host and who will be responsible for recording and action items.

I'll send a calendar invite once I get the 2-sentence summary in the body (Ben — thanks for drafting). Looking forward — Claire

Claire Huang
Executive Assistant to Ravi Malik, CIO
SunForge
